title: VOOL Portal – manage EV chargers, users and billing
description: One place to manage charging sites, users, prices and invoices. Works with any OCPP 1.6 or 2.0 charger.

sections.title: Run your charging without the paperwork
sections.lead: Sites, users, prices, invoices and reports in one place. For one building or a network of sites.

items.title: See everything live
items.text: Sessions, energy use and costs for every charger and every site.

items.title: Decide who charges
items.text: Access levels and users, with RFID cards where needed.

items.title: Bill automatically
items.text: Prices, invoices and payments are handled for you, with reports per user or apartment.

items.title: Use any charger
items.text: Works with all OCPP 1.6 and 2.0 chargers, including other brands.

items.title: Open to the public
items.text: Make chargers visible on Google Maps, Waze and other maps in a few clicks.

items.title: Less admin
items.text: Automatic reports, a link to your bookkeeping system and alerts when something needs attention.

sections.title: Earn from chargers that stand idle
sections.text: Open a charger for public use, set your own price and availability, and track usage in real time. Payments are collected automatically.

items.title: All software features
items.text: App, Portal, roaming, integrations and connectivity on one page.

items.title: Billing and payments
items.text: How drivers pay, how you are paid and what it costs.

sections.title: Want to see the Portal with your own site?
